name: paginator
gotchas: MatPaginator only emits `(page)` events — it does not slice your data itself; wire it through `MatTableDataSource.paginator` instead of reimplementing slicing by hand.
`pageSize` must be one of the values in `pageSizeOptions` (or `hidePageSize` must be true), or Angular's dev-mode change detection can throw `ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError`.
`length` must track the *unpaginated* total record count, not the current page's row count, or the last-page button computes the wrong page index.
